meta.name: story-long-scan
meta.description: 长篇网文扫榜。分析起点、番茄、晋江等平台排行榜数据，提炼市场趋势与热门题材。触发方式：/story-long-scan、/长篇扫榜、「长篇什么火」「起点排行」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析网文榜单，提炼市场热点与热门题材
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是网文作者或编辑,想了解平台榜单背后的热门题材趋势。
copy.tagline_en: Scan web novel rankings to identify hot genres and trends.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're a web novel author or editor wanting to understand market trends from ranking data.

howto.what: Claude 会当长篇网文市场分析师：抓取起点、番茄、晋江等平台排行榜数据，产出扫榜报告（题材热度、新题材信号、关键数据），并生成「选题决策.md」给出 2-3 个选题建议。
howto.when: 当你说「/长篇扫榜」「长篇什么火」等说法，或要求分析起点这类平台的排行榜时触发；它会先问你关注哪个平台和题材方向。

say.text: /长篇扫榜，看看起点最近什么题材火
say.note: 它会先问平台与题材方向

say.text: 扫一下番茄男频阅读榜，找上升中的题材
say.note: 采集后输出题材热度排行

say.text: 根据这次扫榜结果，给我几个选题方向
say.note: 写入 选题决策.md，含可行性与风险

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a web-novel market analyst: it collects ranking data from Qidian, Fanqie, Jinjiang and others, then outputs a scan report (genre heat, new genre signals, key data) and a topic-decision file with 2-3 picks.
howto.when_en: Triggers on /story-long-scan, /长篇扫榜 or “长篇什么火”, or when you ask what's hot in long-form web novels on Qidian and similar platforms.

say_en.text: /长篇扫榜 — what genres are hot on Qidian right now?
say_en.note: It first asks which platform and topic.

say_en.text: Scan Fanqie's male-channel reading rank and find rising genres.
say_en.note: Outputs a genre heat ranking table.

say_en.text: Give me a few topic ideas based on this scan.
say_en.note: Writes 选题决策.md with feasibility and risks.
